item.title: Democratic-led states sue to stop Trump from withholding $600M in health grants
item.description: Four Democratic-led states that have become frequent targets of President Donald Trump sued Wednesday to try to block his administration from cutting off hundreds of millions in public health grants .

item.title: Jaren Jackson Jr. scores 23 in home debut as Jazz deal the Kings their 14th straight loss
item.description: SALT LAKE CITY (AP) — Jaren Jackson Jr scored 23 points in his home debut to lead the Utah Jazz to a 121-93 victory over the Sacramento Kings on Wednesday night. Lauri Markkanen scored 19 points to help the Jazz win their second straight game.

item.title: All-Stars Jokic and Murray lead Nuggets past scrappy Grizzlies 122-116
item.description: DENVER (AP) — Nikola Jokic and Jamal Murray warmed up for their appearances in the NBA's All-Star festivities by teaming up to help the Denver Nuggets hold off the Memphis Grizzlies 122-116 Wednesday night.

item.title: Harden turns playmaker in Cavaliers' home debut as Cleveland routs the Wizards
item.description: CLEVELAND (AP) — James Harden showed in his first two games with the Cleveland Cavaliers that he can come up with the big shot and key defensive play in the clutch.

item.title: Fox and Wembanyama lead the Spurs past the Warriors 126-113 for their 6th straight win
item.description: SAN FRANCISCO (AP) — De'Aaron Fox scored 27 points and Victor Wembanyama added 26 to send the San Antonio Spurs into the All-Star break on a six-game winning streak after beating the Golden State Warriors 126-113 Wednesday night.

item.title: Kawhi Leonard hits a 3-point play with 2 seconds left as the Clippers beat the Rockets
item.description: HOUSTON (AP) — Kawhi Leonard scored 27 points and his three-point play with two seconds remaining lifted the Los Angeles Clippers to a 105-102 victory over the Houston Rockets on Wednesday night.

item.title: Bangladesh votes in its first election since the 2024 Gen Z uprising that ousted Hasina
item.description: DHAKA, Bangladesh (AP) — Voters cast ballots across Bangladesh on Thursday in a parliamentary election seen as a critical test of the country’s democracy after years of political turmoil.

item.title: Orioles add veteran right-hander Chris Bassitt to rotation, AP source says
item.description: Chris Bassitt is staying in the AL East. The Baltimore Orioles agreed to an $18.5 million, one-year contract with the right-hander Wednesday, according to a person familiar with the deal.
